about.name: Shanaaz Ahamed
about.title: Software Engineer
about.description: Dedicated Software Engineer with a passion for solving complex technical challenges. Proficient in Java, Python, and JavaScript, with expertise in modern frameworks like Spring Boot and Angular, as well as DevOps tools including Docker, Kubernetes, and Liquibase. Currently building full-stack features and automated release pipelines for VIDA4, a widely used Health Information System (HIS) deployed across the Middle East. Upgraded and customized Keycloak IAM solution, and currently pursuing an MSc in Computer Science (Cloud Computing) at the University of Moratuwa.

descriptions: Develop features for the Finance and Admin modules of the microservices-based VIDA4 Health Information System (HIS) using Spring Boot and Angular.
Take ownership of assigned Features, Change Requests (CRs), and critical production support (SWAT) tickets, striving for minimal bugs by thoroughly documenting testing and results.
Collaborated with the Research & Development team upon joining to streamline pipelines by automating deployment artifacts.
Upgraded the Keycloak to v26 by developing custom UIs and SPIs to decouple modifications from the core codebase for highly maintainable future upgrades.
Researched and evaluated infrastructure improvements, including the migration of object storage from Minio to CEPH.
Developed an MDT (Minimization of Drive Tests) Data Processing & Visualization web application utilizing ReactJS, Mapbox, and a Python Flask backend[cite: 1].
Retrieved and cleaned raw telecommunications data from AWS to build cell-level and grid-level overlapping indicator summary tables[cite: 1].
Researched and evaluated time series models for anomaly detection and network performance monitoring on mobile network data.

projects.title: Enhancing Outdoor Computer Vision in Resource-Constrained Environments
projects.description: Final year research project: Engineered a dynamic model-switching mechanism that automatically adapts to changing environmental domains (lighting, weather), combined with deep learning model pruning & quantization for edge deployment.

projects.title: Canny Edge Detection from Scratch
projects.description: Canny edge detection implemented from first principles in Python with grayscale conversion, Gaussian blur, gradient estimation, non-maximum suppression and dual thresholding, using only NumPy and Matplotlib.
